issues.failure_explanation: (4.3-1)/(4.4) only give the slack (Δt)_m^{3/2}, where Δt is the maximal step. The chain writes δ_m^{3/2}, which is smaller because δ_m ≤ (Δt)_m, so the inequality is unjustified. After dividing by δ_m, the true error term is (Δt)_m^{3/2}/δ_m. The time grid may be nonuniform, since Assumption 4.3 only requires Δt→0, so this term need not vanish (e.g. δ_m=(Δt)_m^2). Hence the 'o(1)' conclusion fails.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Choose exact maximizers of v^{h_m}-φ over a compact neighbourhood (finitely many time levels, continuous functions), or use a tolerance o(min_i(t_i-t_{i-1})). Then the extra term divided by δ_m vanishes.
issues.overall_effect: The subsolution (and, symmetrically, supersolution) step of Theorem 4.5 is not established for nonuniform time grids.
issues.title: Near-maximizer tolerance (Δt)^{3/2} silently replaced by δ_m^{3/2}
issues.why_classification: A local change in the choice of maximizers restores the argument with no change to the result or method.

issues.failure_explanation: Lemma 4.11 requires Σ_{|α|≤3} sup|D^αφ| ≤ C_1, so that (Dφ(x),D²φ(x)) ∈ 𝒟. Lemma 4.9 only bounds each derivative by C_1, so the sum can be about #α·C_1, and |Dv^h| ≤ √d C_1, |D²v^h| ≤ dC_1. The lower bound of Lemma 4.11, which picks p=p_0, γ=γ_0 ∈ 𝒟, is therefore not justified. The test function φ(t_{k_m+1},·) is an arbitrary C^3 function whose derivatives need not be ≤ C_1 at all.

issues.failure_explanation: Take the two closest nodes, at distance 2Δ_2x, and data g = 1 and −1 there and 0 elsewhere. Since I(g) interpolates g, the mean value theorem on the segment (inside the convex cube) gives |DI(g)(ξ)| ≥ 1/Δ_2x. So sup|∂_m I(g)| ≥ 1/(√d Δ_2x) → ∞ while max|g|=1. This contradicts a constant C uniform in h for |α|_1=1, and similarly for orders 2 and 3, e.g. g=min(|x|,1) forces D²I(g) ≳ 1/Δ_1x. Thus either the lemma is false or Assumption 4.3 is never satisfiable, which would make the theorem vacuous. The lemma rests only on a citation, which cannot support this.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: No complete source-supported repair identified; at minimum, a repair must replace the uniform C^3 control of v^h with a valid stability/consistency mechanism compatible with interpolation (e.g. monotonicity-type estimates or derivative bounds in terms of data smoothness without loss of derivatives), and reprove Lemma 4.9 and the consistency step of Theorem 4.5.
issues.overall_effect: Lemma 4.9's uniform C^3 bounds lose their proof. They are in fact false for Lipschitz f, since v^h(t_{n-1},·)≈I(f) when Δt≪Δx. Theorem 4.5 relies on these bounds for finiteness of v̄, for applying Lemma 4.11, and for J_m→0 via Lipschitz bounds on F(t,·;v^h). The main convergence claim is therefore unsupported.
issues.title: Derivative stability of the interpolant (Lemma 4.8) is false for |α|_1 ≥ 1
issues.why_classification: The central stability ingredient is false and no comparable proof of the main theorem survives without new proof architecture.

issues.failure_explanation: ζ(x/R)=1 is only guaranteed for |x| ≤ R. The cube (-R,R)^d contains points, and possibly nodes, with |x| up to √d R. There ũ^ε ≠ u^ε, so I(ũ^ε) ≠ I(u^ε), and the claimed equality |u^ε−I(u^ε)| = |ũ^ε−I(ũ^ε)| on the whole cube fails for d ≥ 2.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Take ζ=1 on {|x| ≤ √d} (or on the unit cube). Constants change only, and the rate and statement are unchanged.
issues.overall_effect: The proof of Lemma 4.10, used for J_m→0 and the terminal condition in Theorem 4.5, is invalid as written for d ≥ 2.
issues.title: Cut-off ζ(x/R) is not identically 1 on the cube (-R,R)^d for d ≥ 2
issues.why_classification: A one-line change of the cutoff preserves the argument, rate and result.

issues.failure_explanation: φ is defined only on 𝒪, and the inf ranges over |√δ w| ≤ δ^{1/2−θ}. For x ∈ 𝒪 with dist(x,∂𝒪) < δ^{1/2−θ}, the points x+√δw leave 𝒪, so the expression is undefined. Hence no δ_1 works uniformly in x ∈ 𝒪, contrary to the quantifier order in the statement. The proof's δ_1 is chosen after fixing x.
issues.least_adequate_overall_repair: Require x in a compact subset K ⊂ 𝒪 (or dist(x,∂𝒪) ≥ r>0), with δ_1 depending on K. In Theorem 4.5, take 𝒪 a ball around x and K a smaller ball containing all y_m.
issues.overall_effect: Lemma 4.11 is false as quantified, but the theorem uses it only at points y_m → x, where a localized version suffices.
issues.title: δ_1 cannot be uniform over all x in the open set 𝒪
issues.why_classification: A standard localization of the quantifier fixes it with no change to the method or conclusion.
